Usage: memoriahub login [options]

Authorize this machine and store a token

Options:
  --server <url>        Server URL (or set MEMORIAHUB_SERVER_URL)
  --token <pat>         Skip the device flow and use an existing personal access
                        token (headless)
  --device-name <name>  Name shown for this machine in the Access Tokens page
  --no-browser          Do not try to open a browser; just print the URL
  -h, --help            display help for command

Examples:
  memoriahub login                                   Device flow, prompting for the server
  memoriahub login --server https://app.example.com  Device flow, no prompt
  memoriahub login --server https://app.example.com --token pat_...

In CI, skip this command entirely and set:
  MEMORIAHUB_SERVER_URL and MEMORIAHUB_TOKEN
